description: This Java source file defines the 'Zoomer' class, which handles double-touch zoom gestures with animation support for a graphical interface, likely in an Android application. It includes methods for starting, computing, and aborting zoom animations, utilizing an interpolator for smooth transitions.

classes.name: Zoomer
classes.description: A class to animate double-touch zoom gestures with smooth interpolations for Android.

methods.name: forceFinished
methods.description: Sets the finished state of the zoom animation without changing the current zoom value.

methods.name: abortAnimation
methods.description: Stops the animation and sets the current zoom to the end zoom value.

methods.name: startZoom
methods.description: Initiates a zoom animation from 1.0 to the specified end zoom factor.

methods.name: computeZoom
methods.description: Calculates the current zoom level based on elapsed time and determines if the animation is still ongoing.
